versions.changelog:
- Removed the redundant file skill-card.md.
- No user-facing functional changes; documentation and implementation remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the code review tool based on Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Provides multi-dimensional code review and scoring capabilities via server API
- Requires user API key (XBY_APIKEY); prompts user if missing and securely stores the key
- Supports functions for overall code review, git diff review, single file review, and score parsing
- Enforces strict workflow: intent recognition, parameter extraction, tool selection, and result display using raw API data
